fixture_name: Four-lane arterial improvement — US preliminary design (FHWA case study, PD)
subject: judge-baseline

justifications.substance: Closely-spaced intersection queuing/turning/parking interference on a corridor with recorded high-accident designations is a classic, substantive preliminary-design-stage safety concern under FHWA RSA practice.
justifications.evidence_grounding: EV-US-016 provides a verbatim quote ('Queued, turning, and parking vehicles around the closely-spaced intersections at Clear Lake Ave. and the south service road may interfere with each other.') that directly supports the pivotal conflict claim, exceeding registry-id-only citation.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Correctly filed as a safety_concern with no compliance claim or normative basis asserted, keeping the safety concern categorically distinct from framework compliance questions per FHWA RSA semantics.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Recommendation is specific and actionable—restrict turning movements and relocate parking stalls outside the intersection functional area—and is viable to implement at preliminary design stage.
justifications.vru_coverage: Pedestrians and cyclists are explicitly acknowledged as potentially present along the commercial corridor, but the vehicle-to-vehicle conflict mechanism makes VRU impacts not applicable here, meriting an acknowledgment score.

justifications.substance: Queue spillback between signals only 650 ft apart is a well-recognized safety/operational hazard (intersection blockage, rear-end risk) and checking storage/coordination is squarely relevant at preliminary design.
justifications.evidence_grounding: Pivotal claim (650 ft spacing between the two signalized intersections) is supported by a verbatim quote from EV-US-001; the spillback inference is transparently labelled as derived, and the secondary high-accident context is corroborated by the cited FHWA case-study table in the confidence basis.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Correctly filed as a safety_concern with no compliance/normative basis asserted, keeping the safety question categorically distinct from any regulatory check per FHWA RSA semantics.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Recommendation is specific and actionable (signal coordination, Do Not Block Intersection signing, conspicuity enhancements) and viable to carry into preliminary design; complemented by the statement's queue-storage check.
justifications.vru_coverage: Pedestrians and cyclists are explicitly acknowledged as crossing at both signals, but impacts on them are judged not applicable to the queue-spillback mechanism, matching the acknowledge-and-scope pattern scored 1.
